detail: refused: R 2.15 can no longer install packages on Windows. CRAN has retired the Windows package index for every R before 4.0, so https://cloud.r-project.org/bin/windows/contrib/2.15/PACKAGES is gone and install.packages() prints a warning, installs nothing and still reports success -- this app would install and then fail at its first library() call. That is CRAN's change, not a fault in this installer or on this computer. Ways round it: ask whoever published this app for a build on R 4.0 or newer, which CRAN still serves; or, if this R version is essential, for one whose install command names the archive instead (repos = "https://cran-archive.r-project.org/bin/windows/contrib/2.15"), or builds the packages from source with Rtools. R on Linux is unaffected: CRAN serves source packages for every version.

label: refusals: R<4.0 CRAN, Python 2 non-ASCII TEMP
detail: refused: This app needs a temporary folder whose path is plain ASCII (%TEMP%) first, and this installer can't install it. Python 2's pip joins that folder's path as bytes and gives up on any letter outside plain ASCII, so it can install nothing while %TEMP% points inside a folder with an accented or non-English name. That is Python 2's own limitation -- it was retired in 2020 and its last pip was never fixed for this -- and not a fault on this computer or with your user name. Three ways round it: set TEMP and TMP to a folder whose whole path is plain ASCII, such as C:\Temp (Settings, System, About, Advanced system settings, Environment Variables), and run this installer again; or install from a user account whose name is plain ASCII; or ask whoever published this app for a Python 3 build, which has no such limit.
